acceptance_criteria: All disclosed paper sizes, instance counts, cutoffs, signed-cubic graph rules, and approximation-ratio definitions are executed by the isolated runner.
Exact Ising denominators have zero reported MILP gap, and every RQAOA energy satisfies the recursive energy identity and the independently proved optimum bound.
The Appendix C correlation formula agrees with an independent statevector calculation and the exact MILP agrees with brute force on a small signed-cubic graph.
Because the paper omits the exact random graph and coupling samples, agreement is judged on the frozen ensemble distribution; an unmatched bar cannot by itself become a paper-error candidate.
All 16 analytic items receive a claim-addressed executable result.
Finite enumeration, formula checks, and statevector cross-checks never count as proofs or promote scientific coverage.
The isolated run reads no paper PDF, source image, author array, or author reproduction code.
